clue.text: Wise collaborator gets the laurel here

definitions.note: the definition points to a place, standing for 'this place'

parts.note: the comedian Eric Morecambe worked in a double act with Ernie Wise
the bay tree is the laurel

explanation.surface: A comic's partner is honoured with a victor's laurel wreath at some venue.
explanation.walkthrough: Morecambe and Wise were a famous British comedy double act; MORECAMBE BAY is a large bay in north-west England. 'Wise' looks like an adjective but is the comedian's surname.
explanation.definitionFit: The clue's 'here' stands for a location, and the bay is a coastal place in Lancashire.

clue.text: Has to be a wild nag

definitions.text: Has to be a wild nag

parts.note: something that has to be is a must

indicators.note: a wild version of the letters is a disordered one, so the word nag is rearranged

explanation.surface: A rule that a certain horse must be untamed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' turns NAG into ANG after MUST; the whole clue also describes the horse, so it is an all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: A mustang is a feral horse of the American plains, an untamed nag.

clue.text: Calm Mrs Ruff covering about one length

indicators.note: the bird's name is wrapped around the other letters, covering them

parts.note: the ruff is a wading bird whose female is called a reeve

indicators.note: about signals that the pair for one and length is turned round

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone soothes a lady called Mrs Ruff by wrapping her in something long.
explanation.walkthrough: The female ruff (a bird) is a REEVE; 'about' turns IL into LI, which goes inside it after RE.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve worry or pain is to soothe or ease it, a synonym of calm as a verb.

clue.text: Horticulturist's sweet topknot?

definitions.note: read as 'a horticulturist's (plant)', a noun for something a gardener grows

parts.note: a sweet is candy
a topknot is a tuft of hair on the head

explanation.surface: A gardener's sugary hairstyle is wondered about.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the 'sweet topknot' is a flower's name built from two words, not a hairstyle.
explanation.definitionFit: Candytuft is a garden flowering plant of the genus Iberis, grown by gardeners.

clue.text: Measure of rhythm in verse

definitions.meaning: a unit of length in the metric system
the pattern of stressed beats in a line of poetry

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a basic metric unit of length and the regular beat pattern of poetry.

clue.text: Some time before king Lear, that is, anyhow

indicators.note: anyhow means in any old way, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
ie is the abbreviation for id est, that is
R is short for rex, king

explanation.surface: A tale of a king named Lear in the past, told carelessly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyhow' shuffles R, LEAR and IE together.
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier means at a previous time, prior to now.

clue.text: A pronoun few find frightening

parts.note: we is a first-person plural pronoun
a few people are some of them

explanation.surface: A grammatical word that a handful of people find scary.
explanation.definitionFit: Awesome in its older sense means inspiring awe or dread, so alarming.

clue.text: Discerning form of I spy practice

definitions.note: used as a noun, the act or quality of discernment

indicators.note: a form of the words means they are reshaped, rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Playing I spy is good training for sharp observation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form of' rearranges the twelve letters of I SPY PRACTICE.
explanation.definitionFit: Perspicacity is keen insight, the quality of perceiving clearly.

clue.text: Slip one rectified in a letter to the Greeks

indicators.note: something rectified is put right, so the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: An error in an epistle to the Greek people is corrected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rectified' rearranges SLIP ONE. 'a letter to the Greeks' sounds like an epistle but means a letter of their alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsilon is the fifth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Suffering of chaps in wrong environment

indicators.note: in places the chaps inside the word for wrong, which forms their surroundings

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
chaps are men

explanation.surface: The distress felt by men in an unpleasant setting.
explanation.walkthrough: TORT is a legal term for a wrong done to someone; 'environment' reinforces that it surrounds MEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Torment is severe mental or physical pain, a synonym of anguish.

clue.text: Attending the playhouse's closing night?.

parts.note: going to a show, or read differently, the theatre itself departing on its final night

explanation.surface: Someone goes to see a show on its last evening.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase can mean going to the theatre, or the theatre going, closing for good.
explanation.definitionFit: Theatregoing is the habit of attending plays, which fits attending a playhouse.

clue.text: Abject toil of East European grinding grain

parts.note: a Slav is a member of a people of eastern Europe

indicators.note: grinding crushes and breaks up the grain, so its letters are mixed

parts.note: rye is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: Hard labour of an eastern European peasant milling corn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grinding' turns RYE into ERY after SLAV.
explanation.definitionFit: Slavery is forced unpaid labour, the most degrading kind of work.

clue.text: It summarises a sort of cookery book

definitions.text: It summarises a sort of cookery book

parts.words: It summarises a sort of cookery book
parts.note: a condensed abridgement, playing on a book that boils things down

explanation.surface: Describing a précis of a recipe collection.
explanation.definitionFit: An epitome is a summary or abstract of a written work.

clue.text: Where to look for a blazer, starting in Gleneagles Hotel

definitions.text: Where to look for a blazer

indicators.note: the answer is the letters at the very start of the words that follow

explanation.surface: The place to find a smart jacket at the start of a stay at a famous Scottish hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: A blazer here is a blazing fire, not a jacket; Gleneagles is a well-known Scottish golf hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingle is a fireside or hearth, where a fire burns.

clue.text: Experienced baptismal immersion?

definitions.meaning: being dunked in water, read as going below the surface

explanation.definitionFit: The word means went through something, and split up it also describes going beneath the water at a baptism.

clue.text: Mistaking in odd way deeds of gallantry

indicators.note: in places the word for mistaking inside the other letters
the odd way of writing the word means its letters are rearranged

parts.note: erring means making a mistake

explanation.surface: Doing heroic acts the wrong way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd way' rearranges ODD to DDO, and ERRING goes 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Derring-do is daring action, heroic exploits.

clue.text: About time to change a height recorder

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for change goes around the other one

parts.note: to alter is to change
taken as written

explanation.surface: It is high time an instrument measuring elevation was altered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like 'approximately' but tells you ALTER goes around TIME.
explanation.definitionFit: An altimeter is an instrument showing an aircraft's height above sea level.

clue.text: Oberon's spouse in a Titian reproduction

indicators.note: a reproduction is a copy, and here a remade arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: The fairy queen's likeness appears in a copy of a Renaissance painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reproduction' rearranges A TITIAN; Titian was a Venetian painter.
explanation.definitionFit: In Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream the fairy king Oberon is married to this queen.

clue.text: Emanate a variety of sirenian

indicators.note: a variety is a different form, so the letters take another order

explanation.surface: Something issuing from a kind of sea creature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a variety of' rearranges EMANATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sirenians are the order of aquatic mammals including the sea cow and dugong.

clue.text: Frill decoration in the French way

indicators.note: in places the decoration inside the French street

parts.note: rue is French for street
CH is Companion of Honour, a British decoration

explanation.surface: A frilly ornament in the style of Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the French way' reads like 'in French style', but it puts CH inside RUE.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruche is a gathered strip of fabric used to trim garments.

clue.text: Cultivates Eliza Doolittle, say

parts.note: makes polished, as Professor Higgins does to the flower girl in Pygmalion

explanation.surface: Teaching a Cockney flower seller to speak properly.
explanation.walkthrough: Eliza Doolittle is the Cockney flower girl whom Higgins polishes into a lady in Shaw's Pygmalion.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone cultured and polished is to make them more elegant.

clue.text: Colour identifying a vehicle belonging to me

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
something belonging to me is mine

explanation.surface: Telling which motor is yours by its paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Carmine is a vivid crimson red.

clue.text: Concentrated in a number of Home Counties

parts.note: ten is a number
the Home Counties around London lie in the south-east of England, SE

explanation.surface: Focused in several counties around London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the English counties surrounding London, in the South East.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense means strong or highly focused.

clue.text: Key to fit a place in Surrey

parts.note: E is a musical key
fit means healthy, well

explanation.surface: A key to fit a door somewhere in Surrey.
explanation.walkthrough: Ewell is a town in Surrey, a county south of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Ewell is a town near Epsom in the county south-west of London.

clue.text: Conjecture on recalling part of Dante's great work

parts.note: to infer is to deduce or conjecture

indicators.note: recalling means calling back, so the word on runs backwards

explanation.surface: Guessing while remembering a section of the Divine Comedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalling' turns ON into NO after INFER.
explanation.definitionFit: The first part of Dante's Divine Comedy depicts Hell.

clue.text: Get zany about a Chinese flower

indicators.note: about here means scattered around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Going crazy over a blossom from China.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'flower' is something that flows, a river; 'about' rearranges GET ZANY.
explanation.definitionFit: The great river of China flows from Tibet to Shanghai.

clue.text: Herbal tonic for a swell Scot

parts.note: a swell is a fashionable gentleman, a gent
Ian is a typical Scottish name

explanation.surface: A herbal remedy suited to a fine Scottish gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentian root is bitter and was long taken as a stomach tonic.

clue.text: Inspect American tourist style

parts.note: examine something, in casual American slang as a sightseer might say

explanation.surface: How a visitor from the USA would examine the sights.
explanation.definitionFit: To have a quick glance at something, expressed in informal US idiom.
